body:
Fixes #80

## Summary

- Route open-ended software artifact requests to `software_project_plan` instead of `unknown` across extensions, plugins, bots, apps, services, websites, CLIs, APIs, SDKs, scrapers, libraries, dashboards, and GitHub Actions.
- Formalize the first turn as a Links Notation `software_project_request` with a requirement graph, requirement categories, subtasks, delivery mode, implementation language, and approval gates before producing a plan.
- Keep code/scripts/manual instructions behind approval; `approve plan` returns `software_project_implementation` with language-aware starter code for TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, or Rust, while the Owlbear/D&D tracker branch keeps the HP, Protection, Resistance, damage mitigation, and cooldown TypeScript core.
- Expand the full-dialogue regression matrix to 22 popular programming tasks and assert formalization, reasoning steps, requirement graph, approval gates, plan text, approval follow-up, and generated code shape for each example.
- Fix delivery-mode detection so `JavaScript` no longer matches the standalone `script` request path; browser worker parity is updated too.
- Merge latest `origin/main` to clear the PR conflict and keep the issue #63 definition-fusion changes.

## Reproduction

Before this PR, the reported Owlbear prompt returned `intent: unknown`:

```text
Hi, can you write for me extension for owlbear? I am currently leading some dnd games and i want to try wargame. So, i need extensions that can track hp for different units, that can track Protection and Resistance stacks on unit an will reduce damage count on those stats. Also this extension should track cooldown of some abilities
```

The first response now returns `software_project_plan`, renders `software_project_request`, includes `Requirement model`, `Subtasks`, reasoning, approval gates, and a proposed implementation plan, and intentionally does not emit code yet.

A follow-up `approve plan` with the prior conversation returns `software_project_implementation` with `approval_state approved` and the generated starter code surface. The regression matrix covers 22 full dialogues across React/web apps, Python APIs/CLIs/scrapers, Rust CLIs/libraries, GitHub Actions, browser extensions, Discord/Telegram bots, Node APIs, services, SDKs, scrapers, libraries, dashboards, manual-instruction mode, script-generation mode, and WebVM/immediate-execution approval gates.

## Verification

- `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
- `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features`
- `cargo test --test unit software_project -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test --test unit -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test --all-features --verbose`
- `cargo test --doc --verbose`
- `node --check src/web/formal_ai_worker.js`
- `rust-script scripts/check-file-size.rs` (passes; warnings only for pre-existing near-limit files)
- `npm ci --prefix tests/e2e`
- `npm run --prefix tests/e2e check:i18n`
- `npm run --prefix tests/e2e test:local -- --grep "Owlbear extension request returns a software project plan"`
- `npm run --prefix tests/e2e test:local`
- `git diff --check`
- `git diff --cached --check`

## Notes

No screenshots are included because this is a symbolic solver/browser-worker behavior change, not a visual UI change.
